author: soccerblast
body: I got banned in feb because of aimbot but I don't use aimbot or any other hacked client I mean I can see why he thought that I was in a corner smacking him and he could hardly hit me and he was only going forward so easy combo. I got very pissed when I got banned because either the staff got pissed that he died or he thought I was hacking. I love this server and want to play again if you need to check my Minecraft out through Skype just ask me. Thx for your time.
